labelled_recipe_link_wins.description:
My best weeknight curry!

RECIPE: https://sampleblog.com/weeknight-curry

My knives (affiliate): https://amzn.to/3xyz
Instagram: https://instagram.com/chefsample
Support me: https://patreon.com/chefsample
labelled_recipe_link_wins.why: A link explicitly labelled RECIPE must sort first; affiliate/social links must be dropped entirely.

affiliate_and_social_all_skipped.description:
Links:
https://amzn.to/abc
https://www.instagram.com/chefsample
https://tiktok.com/@chefsample
https://bit.ly/shortened
https://facebook.com/chefsample
https://mystore.com/shop
affiliate_and_social_all_skipped.why: Every link here is on the skip list, so nothing should be fetched.

bare_links_capped_at_two.description: See https://a-blog.com/one and https://b-blog.com/two and https://c-blog.com/three
bare_links_capped_at_two.why: Outbound fetches are bounded to 2 to keep the function inside its time budget.

trailing_punctuation_stripped.why: A URL wrapped in parentheses must not carry the closing bracket into the fetch.

duplicate_links_deduped.why: The labelled link and the bare link are the same page — one fetch, not two.

no_links_at_all.description: Just me cooking. Recipe is in the video, sorry!
no_links_at_all.why: Falls through to the description/transcript tiers.
